name: codify-rule
description: Turn a repeated mistake into a durable, path-scoped rule in .claude/rules/. Triggers on "codify this rule", "make a rule so this doesn't happen again", "/codify-rule", "закодифікуй правило", "петля помилка-правило". Use only when the same mistake showed up TWICE (twice = a pattern, once = noise). Names the wrong shape and the right shape with one short example of each, scopes the rule to the paths that matter, and leaves the edit in the working tree so the next agent on this repo inherits the fix. Edits only .claude/rules/; never commits or pushes.
